what: Three hand-written HeLL programs assembled to Classic Malbolge with the vendored LMAO and executed on the classic oracle malbolge.py.
mechanism: counter5 advances a 5-cycle on every call and prints 'W' when the cycle wraps. carry_5x2 adds a second 2-cycle that advances only when the 5-cycle wraps ('5' at the first wrap of LOW, 'X' at the wrap of HIGH), which is the ripple-carry mechanism the LMAO adder uses for decimal digits. print_h loads 'H' by rotating 216 (rot(216)=72) and outputs it.
